scripts.migrate:livevariant: wrangler d1 migrations apply livevariant-accounts --env production --remote
scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply livevariant-accounts --env dev --local

LV_SERVE_URL.description: Optional. Leave empty to serve everything from one domain, which is the simplest setup. Set it to a second domain if you send bulk email and want campaign links on their own hostname, so a campaign's reputation never touches your dashboard's.

LV_ALLOWED_DESTINATIONS.description: Optional, comma-separated hostnames redirects may send visitors to (a hostname admits its subdomains). Anyone can author a test config pointing anywhere, so set this on a deployment reachable from the internet to stop yours being used as an open redirector.

LV_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.description: Optional, comma-separated page origins allowed to drive tests through the SDK (/choose, /reward). Leave empty to accept any origin; set it if only your own sites should be able to run tests against this deployment.

LV_UNLISTED_DESTINATIONS.description: Optional: what redirects do with a destination not on LV_ALLOWED_DESTINATIONS. 'allow', 'block', or 'interstitial' (visitors see an explicit 'Redirecting you to...' screen). Empty keeps the defaults: allow everything with no list, block unlisted with one.

LV_ASSET_SECRET.description: Optional. Enables image hosting (uploads at /assets, download URLs signed per serve). Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Leave empty to run without image hosting.

LV_API_TOKEN.description: Optional. When set, calling the tools API (/api/v1) and the MCP endpoint requires this value as a Bearer token: your server-to-server credential. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Leave empty to keep the API open.
